clips.title: 三点
clips.summary: 凌晨三点，老顾客老周照例来买烟
clips.context: 阿青在便利店值夜班，老周每天凌晨三点来买一包烟。

action.text: 冷白灯管下的三排货架，收银台上一盏暖黄台灯照着站在后面的阿青
action.en: cold white tube lights over three aisles; a small warm desk lamp on the counter lights the clerk standing behind it

sound.en: the low hum of a fridge

move.why: 空店从四面压向收银台后的她，孤独一点点收紧

action.text: 她抬起左手看了一眼旧电子表
action.en: she raises her left hand and glances at her old digital watch

action.text: 玻璃门被推开，老周湿着肩膀走进来
action.en: the glass door swings open and the older man walks in with rain-wet shoulders

shots.name: 递烟
shots.hand: 阿青的右手（年轻女人的手，深蓝色旧袖口）

action.text: 她从柜台下摸出一包素白烟盒，放在台面上
action.en: it takes a plain white cigarette pack from under the counter and sets it on the countertop

shots.hand_en: the clerk's right hand (a young woman's hand, worn dark-blue sleeve cuff)

clips.constraint: 收银台在门的左手边；店里只有阿青和老周。
clips.summary_en: At three in the morning, a regular customer comes into a quiet convenience store for his usual pack of cigarettes.

turn.from: 空店里一个人数着时间

signature.why: 过肩看玻璃门被推开：冷白灯管下的湿肩膀、暖黄台灯的冷暖对冲、风铃一响打破冰柜的嗡声

clips.tension: 她在等一个每天三点来的人，表已经走过三点，门外只有雨；观众和她一样不知道他今天会不会来

clips.title: 雨停
clips.summary: 老周付钱离开，屋檐下躲雨的人散了

action.en: she slides the change across the counter

crowd.doing: 在门外屋檐下躲雨，陆续走开
crowd.doing_en: sheltering under the awning outside, then drifting away one by one

action.text: 老周推门出去，走进渐小的雨里
action.en: the older man pushes the door open and walks out into the thinning rain

move.why: 门关上以后店一点点变大，她在画面里越来越小

action.en: she watches the door without a word

clips.summary_en: The customer pays and leaves; the people sheltering from the rain outside drift away.

turn.from: 她第一次开口说话，有了一点暖意
turn.to: 门关上，店里又只剩她一个

signature.why: 朝门口的全景：老周走进渐小的雨，屋檐下的人一个个散去，雨声变小、风铃最后一响

clips.tension: 她想留他多说一句话，雨在停、他在走；她终究没开口，观众知道她想说
